The histopathology of the removed nodule is critical to exclude cholangiocarcinoma or HCC as a cause of recurrence. Current antibiotic status is unconfirmed.
assessment.working: Obstructive jaundice with probable ascending cholangitis; aetiology undetermined pending nodule pathology and microbiology
